sections.text_helper: Section 31.6.22 "TIM capture/compare register 6 (TIM_CCR6)" in chapter 31 (Advanced-control timers (TIM1/TIM8)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1103.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x04C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 19:0 CCR6[19:0]: Compare 6 value
CCR6 is the value to be loaded in the actual compare 6 register (preload value).
It is loaded permanently if the preload feature is not selected in the TIM_CCMR3 register (bit
OC6PE). Else the preload value is copied in the active compare 6 register when an update
event occurs.
The active compare register contains the value to be compared to the counter TIM_CNT and
signaled on tim_oc6 output.
Non-dithering mode (DITHEN = 0)
The register holds the compare value in CCR6[15:0]. The CCR6[19:16] bits are reset.
Dithering mode (DITHEN = 1)
The register holds the integer part in CCR6[19:4]. The CCR6[3:0] bitfield contains the
dithered part.
